question: Who among the following was a renowned pianist and founder of the Shillong Chamber Choir?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neil Nongkynrih**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Neil Nongkynrih** was a renowned pianist and the founder of the **Shillong Chamber Choir**.
 
• He was born in **Shillong, Meghalaya**, and had a deep passion for music from a young age.
 
• The Shillong Chamber Choir, under his leadership, gained national and international acclaim, including winning the reality show **India's Got Talent** in 2010.
 
• Neil Nongkynrih was awarded the **Padma Shri** in 2015 by the Government of India for his contributions to music and the arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shillong Chamber Choir (SCC)**

 
 
• Founded in 2001 by Neil Nongkynrih, the SCC is a multi-genre choir based in Shillong, Meghalaya.
 
• The choir blends western classical music with Indian classical music, creating a unique and eclectic sound.
 
• SCC has performed across India and internationally, including at the Rashtrapati Bhavan for the President of India.
 
• The choir's repertoire includes western classical, jazz, Broadway, and traditional Khasi music.
 
 
 
• **India's Got Talent**
 
 
• India's Got Talent is a televised Indian talent show competition and part of the global Got Talent franchise.
 
• The show features performers of all ages, showcasing a wide variety of talents, including singing, dancing, magic, and acrobatics.
 
• The Shillong Chamber Choir won the second season of India's Got Talent in 2010, which significantly boosted their popularity.
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri**
 
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in India, presented by the Government of India.
 
• It is awarded to individuals for their distinguished contribution in various fields such as arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Neil Nongkynrih received the Padma Shri in 2015 for his exceptional contribution to the field of music.
